episodes.synopsis: Gabimaru, a ninja member of a clan of assassins, is sentenced to death. He claims to have nothing to tie him to life, yet no method of execution manages to end his life. His meeting with Sagiri Yamada Asaemon, who seems to be investigating him, will change everything.
episodes.title: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner

episodes.synopsis: The condemned criminals are gathered on the beach to prepare for the expedition to Shinsenkyo, but first, they must reduce their numbers.
episodes.title: Screening and Choosing

episodes.synopsis: Gabimaru, Sagiri, and the others arrive on Shinsenkyo, and their battle for survival begins.
episodes.title: Weakness and Strength

episodes.synopsis: Gabimaru and Sagiri are in trouble during their first fight against the island's mysterious creatures. Gabimaru is unaware of these monstrosities and this puts him at a disadvantage in battle. The sudden arrival of Yuzuriha, the female ninja, will change the situation, but Gabimaru does not see clearly in her game.
episodes.title: Hell and Paradise

episodes.synopsis: Gabimaru and Sagiri's group cross paths with another Yamada Asaemon, Genji, who takes a dim view of Sagiri's involvement in the present matter. Meanwhile, Yamada Asaemon Tenza tries to find a way off the island along with his charge, Nurugai.
episodes.title: The Samurai and the Woman

episodes.synopsis: Rokurota starts to cause serious problems for Sagiri and Gabimaru, and now they must think of a strategy to defeat him!
episodes.title: Heart and Reason

episodes.synopsis: Chobe and Toma encounter people unlike any they've ever encountered before. Gabimaru and Sagiri's party finally meet people who live on the island.
episodes.title: Flowers and Offerings

episodes.synopsis: Tenza and Nurugai also encounter one of the island's strange denizens with unfathomable power. All seems lost before they encounter another Yamada Asaemon...
episodes.title: Student and Master

episodes.synopsis: Sagiri's group sets off in search of Horai. Gabimaru goes ahead and encounters the same powerful being that confronted Tenza...
episodes.title: Gods and People

episodes.synopsis: Mei attempts to explain something very important to Sagiri's party in the forest. Shion tries to explain how he interacts with the world to Nurugai. A mysterious servant of the Tensen tries to explain why Aza Chobe and Toma shouldn't escape.
episodes.title: Yin and Yang

episodes.synopsis: Chobe brings new abilities to bear as he faces the Tensen's servants. A secret of Mei's is revealed to Gabimaru, hardening his resolve to fight and opening him up to a new perception of the world.
episodes.title: Weak and Strong

episodes.synopsis: Mu Dan confronts Sagiri's party and reveals shocking truths about the island's true nature.
episodes.title: Umbrella and Ink

episodes.synopsis: Sagiri's party faces Mu Dan's seemingly unstoppable true form. Shion does his best to rise to the challenge with his mastery of waves.
episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
